title: MOTION (RAMAN - SOTO-MARTINEZ) relative to funding for the purpose of implementing speed humps / tables or other speed mitigation improvements at, or as…
text:
[Council File 26-1550; CD 4]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (RAMAN - SOTO-MARTINEZ) relative to funding for the purpose of implementing speed humps / tables or other speed mitigation improvements at, or as near as possible, to the intersection of Franklin Avenue and Las Palmas Avenue and the marked crosswalk therein.
Recommendation(s) for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. AUTHORIZE the Bureau of Street Services the use of $30,000 available to Council District 4 from the Hollywood Redevelopment Project Area Special Fund No. 580 (Ordinance No. 184131), for the purpose of implementing speed humps / tables or other speed mitigation improvements at, or as near as possible, to the intersection of Franklin Avenue and Las Palmas Avenue and the marked crosswalk therein;
2. AUTHORIZE the Controller to:
a. Transfer $30,000 available to Council District 4 from the Hollywood Redevelopment Project Area Special Fund No. 580 to the Transportation Trust Fund No. 840/94, Account No. 94VE27 (CD 4 Speed Reduction);
3. AUTHORIZE the Department of Transportation to prepare the necessary Controller instructions and make technical corrections, with the concurrence of the City Administrative Officer, to meet the intention of this motion, and instruct the Controller to implement these instructions.
4. AUTHORIZE the Department of Transportation to make any corrections, clarifications or revisions to the above fund transfer instructions, including any new instructions, in order to effectuate the intent of this Motion, and including any corrections and changes to fund or account numbers; said corrections / clarifications / changes may be made orally, electronically or by any other means.

outcome.text: Council action: Adopted as Amended: by Amending Motion 39A (Price for Raman - Yaroslavsky) (Nov 6, 2026)
